speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs in light of the COVID-19 related travel restrictions for foreigners entering Singapore, whether the foreign spouses of Singapore citizens will be allowed entry into Singapore.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: If they are short-term visitors who need to visit Singapore due to extenuating circumstances, ICA will assess their applications on a case-by-case basis.
